## Task 4 – The menu

**In the webR workspace**, in the cells of Task 4. Try the reference specification and two or three others, changing one argument at a time. Then rerun the one that you would defend, so that it is your last try. The session sends nothing to the class chart, so you leave out `submit_exploration()`.

[Open the webR workspace at Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-menu){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

## Your placement

**In the webR workspace**, in the cells of Task 4. Rerun `try_spec()` with the specification that you would defend and read your placement, which is the number of the 64 specifications whose gap lies further below zero than yours.

[Open the webR workspace at Task 4](../../lab.qmd#task-4-menu){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

To go further: [the replication](../../background.qmd#sec-replication) on the background page.
